title: Returned Payments and Installment Settlement Pricing on Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Rule.** Two or more returned payments of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts (bank returns of posted deficiency payments, as the account ledger records them) dated fewer than 12 whole months before today add 4.0 surcharge points to its installment settlement, exactly one adds 2.0 points, and none adds no points. The points are percentage points of the balance. Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's.

| Returned payments dated fewer than 12 whole months before today | Surcharge points |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 4.0 |
| Exactly one | 2.0 |
| None | None |

## Points of judgement

- Each return counts once, by its own date; returns on the borrower's contract or on another deficiency account are not counted.
- Hypothetically, with today the 8th of a month, a return dated the 9th of the same month a year earlier counts and one dated the 8th of that month a year earlier does not.
- Hypothetically, on a balance of $10,000.00, one return inside the look-back gives 2.0 points, that is $200.00.
